description: This file is a test script for the 'git p4' tool, specifically testing handling of wildcards and special characters in filenames when syncing between Git and Perforce. It includes setup commands, file operations with wildcards, and verification steps for various scenarios such as adding, submitting, copying, renaming, and deleting files with special character names.

methods.description: Starts a Perforce server for testing.
